other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab
Applicant must have regularly deposited his contribution
Applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Applicant must not be a member of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS) or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Applicant must not be an income tax payer
Applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must have a monthly income of ₹15,000 or below
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹51,000 per female child (up to two) as a Fixed Deposit Receipt, encashable at the time of the daughter's marriage.
